replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Math is like a puzzle I love solving. Coming from a family with mixed backgrounds, I appreciate logic. Since my parents have different education levels, I value hard work over innate talent. I enjoy its structure, especially in physics and computer science, where clear rules lead to tangible results. I see it as a tool for understanding the world rather than just an academic requirement.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, no. With low neuroticism, I stay calm under pressure. I prefer structured challenges over vague uncertainty. If something seems difficult, I just break it down into smaller parts. My focus is on progress and understanding concepts deeply rather than worrying about grades or external expectations. Math feels like a safe space for my mind.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used it to check my code and debug physics simulations. It helped me verify my logic without giving direct answers. I prefer using AI as a partner to test my own solutions, not to replace my thinking process. It saved time on repetitive checks, letting me focus on learning the core concepts and applying them creatively.
